acceptance_goals.construction_intent: Countertop, base, display face, sign, supports, trim, and wear anchors remain semantic parts.
acceptance_goals.functional_readability: The asset reads as a usable shop counter with customer-facing display and checkout surface.
acceptance_goals.material_storytelling: Wood, painted trim, glass/display material, signage accent, and contact wear separate by role.
acceptance_goals.silhouette_readability: The broad counter surface, front display, and raised sign create a readable environment prop.

required_features: edge wear and countertop contact wear

style.theme: modular fantasy shop counter with readable use and warm material storytelling
